analysis.reason: 3일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간에서 벗어나 중립 구간으로 진입했으나, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 멈추고 횡보 중이다. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.82배로 위축되어 방향성 확인이 어렵다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'wait and see' stance for the third consecutive day. RSI has moved out of oversold territory into neutral, but MACD histogram improvement has stalled, showing sideways movement. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.82x the 5-day average, making directional confirmation difficult.

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (45.3→50.8) + 과매도 탈출, 중립 구간 진입 판단 + 상승 방향성 확인
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.2639→-0.2504) + 개선 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 약함

[지지·저항 구조]

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.82배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 낮음
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($155.45) vs SMA5 ($154.13)/SMA20 ($155.65)/SMA50 ($155.70) — short-term trend above, mid-term trend below
· Position relative to SMA100 ($150.56)/SMA200 ($145.81) — strong mid-to-long-term trend
· 52-week position (87.5%) + current price level near historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.3→50.8) + exiting oversold, entering neutral zone — upward momentum confirmed
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2639→-0.2504) + improving — weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (middle band $155.65) + band width at 3.51% indicating normal levels
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($154.26) + pivot-based
· Swing resistance ($156.42) + upward trend strengthening upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of directional trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.82x) + low confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + confirmation of conditions for waiting
analysis.patternNote: 일봉상 5일 고가/저가 범위($152.13~$155.74)가 20일 고가/저가 범위($152.13~$158.04) 내에서 횡보하며 뚜렷한 방향성을 보이지 않음.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The daily price range ($152.13-$155.74) is trading sideways within the 20-day range ($152.13-$158.04), showing no clear directional trend.
keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간을 탈출하여 중립 구간으로 진입했으나, MACD 히스토그램 개선세가 멈추며 방향성 확인에 실패.
거래량 비율이 0.82로 위축되어 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도가 낮음.
주봉 ADX 13.1로 무추세 구간으로, 단기 일봉 조정과 혼동하지 않도록 주의 필요.
keyPointsEn: RSI has exited oversold territory and entered neutral, but MACD histogram improvement has stalled, failing to confirm direction.
Volume ratio at 0.82 indicates low confidence in current price movements.
Weekly ADX at 13.1 suggests a non-trending market; caution is needed to avoid confusing short-term daily adjustments with broader trends.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 15.8로 추세 미형성 구간이므로, 현재의 가격 변동은 추세적 붕괴나 상승 전환보다는 되돌림 가능성이 있는 충격성 변동으로 해석해야 한다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 15.8, indicating a lack of established trend, current price fluctuations should be interpreted as shock-like movements with potential for reversal rather than a trend breakdown or initiation.
analysis.continuity: 3일 연속 관망 유지. 직전 판단과 동일하게 RSI는 중립 구간을 유지하고 있으며, MACD 히스토그램 개선세가 멈춘 점이 동일하게 관망의 근거가 된다.
analysis.continuityEn: Maintaining a 'wait and see' stance for the third consecutive day. Similar to the previous assessment, RSI remains in neutral territory, and the stalled improvement in the MACD histogram continues to support a cautious approach.
